name: Angus
title: Angus —
title_em: glens, smokies and a famous Declaration.
tagline: From the Angus Glens to the Arbroath smokies, with a declaration of independence signed in 1320.
summary: Angus sits between the Highlands and the North Sea. Its coast has red sandstone cliffs and harbours, while the Angus Glens rise into the Cairngorms.
The Declaration of Arbroath of 1320 is one of the founding documents of Scottish identity, and Glamis Castle is the childhood home of the late Queen Mother.
